summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing the acquisition of approximately 200 acres of greenfield land in Milam County, Texas for about $100 million in cash, near its existing Rockdale facility. The purchase supports AI/HPC infrastructure development and provides outright ownership to eliminate lease renewal risk. This is an ordinary asset acquisition, not a special-situation corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is a routine current report of business operations, so no special-situation classification applies.
